newsitem.title: USA: GM names new powertrain information officer.
newsitem.headline: GM names new powertrain information officer.

text.p: General Motors Corp. announced Wednesday David Essig has joined the automaker in the new position of chief information officer for GM's Powertrain Group.

Essig was previously manager of the powertrain systems business management department at Ford Motor Co.. At GM, he will be responsible for implementing an information system business plan for the powertrain unit, which makes transmissions, engines and related components for passenger cars and light and medium trucks.

Essig's position is part of a new information systems and services unit GM is assembling to cover its seven main business sectors. Those functions had been performed by Electronic Data Systems Corp, which was spun off from GM in 1996.

He will report to Mike Mutchler, group executive of GM Powertrain Group, and Dan McNicholl, chief information officer for GM's North American Operations. Essig joins Mary Anne Goebel, chief information officer for the GM Truck Group, who also reports to McNicholl. GM has not yet filled a similar position for its car unit.
